label: Usable time in one cycle
subgoals: Subtract register overhead from the clock period
Add the delays of consecutive operations
Stop when the next delay would exceed the usable time

label: Packing a chain into cycles
subgoals: Fill the current cycle with the next operations that fit
Open a new cycle when the next operation does not fit
Compare the chained cycle count with one cycle per operation

label: When chaining hurts
subgoals: Reserve a clock-uncertainty margin in the usable time
Account for multiplexer delay on shared units
Chain only short operations when delay estimates are uncertain
